name: Scooter Reservation API
description: Flask API to find, reserve and end rides on scooters, with a JSON-file database and a simulated payment gateway. Not production-ready: see README, Deploying.

WEB_CONCURRENCY.description: gunicorn worker processes in the one web dyno. Writers are serialised by the DB file lock, so more workers mostly help reads. Never set it to an empty value: gunicorn fails to start.

PAYMENT_FAULT.description: Simulated gateway fault mode. Must be none in production. Leave ENABLE_FAULT_INJECTION unset too (it lets any client force payment faults with a header).

SCOOTER_DB_LOCK_TIMEOUT.description: Seconds a reservation request waits for the DB lock before answering storage_busy (503). Keep it well below the Procfile's gunicorn --timeout (20).

RECONCILE_MAX_ATTEMPTS.description: H3's N: gateway attempts without a charge before make reconcile ends a ride with an outstanding balance.

RECONCILE_MAX_AGE_MINUTES.description: H3's T: minutes since payment started before make reconcile ends an uncharged ride with an outstanding balance.
